data.text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

23 February 2026

ROADS AFFECTED BY THE STATE OF THE PROVINCE ADDRESS (SOPA) MONDAY, 23 FEBRUARY 2026

Members of the public are advised that today, Monday, 23 February 2026, the Premier of Gauteng Province, Mr Panyaza Lesufi, will deliver the State of the Province Address (SOPA) at the Johannesburg Expo Centre, Nasrec. 

The event is expected to cause traffic disruptions in the vicinity between 13h00 and 23h00.

Affected routes:

- Rand Show Road
- Nasrec Road
- Landbou Road
- Recreation Road
- Commerce Street  
- Golden Highway
- Soweto Highway

Additionally,  road closures with traffic and access control will be implemented on Golden Highway between Rand Show Road and Stadium Road, on Ring Road between Commerce Street and Landbou Road, and on Landbou Road between Nasrec Road and Ring Road.

Law enforcement officials will be present to regulate traffic around the Nasrec precinct. Motorists are advised to plan their travel routes accordingly and expect delays in the area. 

Thank you for your cooperation and understanding. Drive safely.

ENDS

Issued by the Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department Communication Unit #SaferJoburg #JoburgRoadSafety #GPSOPA2026

Mga kalsadang bahagi ng Mabuhay Lane Route 1 at 7 sa Quezon City, San Juan, at Mandaluyong ang inikutan ng mga tauhan ng Swift Traffic Action Group (STAG) ngayong araw.

Kahabaan ng Timog Avenue., Tomas Morato Ave., N. Domingo, F. Blumentritt, F. Manalo, M. Marcos, L. Mencias, Acacia Lane, F. Ortigas, P. Cruz, Estrella-Pantaleon, Barangka Drive, Calbayog Ext., Nueve de Pebrero, Wilson St., at Mindanao Ave.

Labimpito ang nahuli sa physical apprehension; 66 sa non-contact apprehension; dalawa naman ang na-impound na sasakyan. Dinala ang mga ito sa MMDA impounding site sa Marikina.
